issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale, contradicting the PR's stated Union-to-pipe migration.
issues.detail: The PR description promises Union/Optional will be banned, but ruff.toml ignores exactly the rules that would enforce it, with a TODO citing 'a lot of errors'. This leaves the codebase in a two-dialect state indefinitely. Either land the sweep now or scope the ignore to specific paths so new code is held to the new shape.

issues.description: default_raise() sentinel and its <3.10 rationale survive after kw_only consolidation.
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universally available, required fields can simply omit defaults. Retaining field(default_factory=default_raise) as a required-field marker now raises RuntimeError at construct time instead of TypeError at the call site, and the accompanying comments still reference dead <3.10 compatibility. Remove the sentinel or update the rationale to reflect the real invariant.

issues.description: Stray `dnf search python3.12` left in the install-scripts CI prep with no assertion.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` between update and install. Its output is unused and failure is ignored, so it neither gates installation nor surfaces signal — pure log noise. Remove it or convert it into an explicit availability precondition that fails fast.

issues.description: Install scripts hardcode python3.12 instead of tracking the supported-version floor.
issues.detail: Prep steps were changed to force python3.12 specifically while the matrix still covers 3.10/3.11/3.12, and install.sh's guard still tests `PYTHON_MINOR_VER < 7` even though pyproject requires >=3.10. The minimum supported version should be a single fact: tighten the shell guard to `< 10` and pin prep to the floor or matrix version.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the Python 3.9 removal is mechanically clean and largely subtractive — the right shape for this work. Two structural concerns dominate: the PR's stated Union-to-pipe migration is contradicted by a blanket ruff ignore of UP007/UP035/UP045, and the default_raise() sentinel plus its <3.10 comments survive even though kw_only=True now expresses required-ness natively. Smaller cleanup gaps remain in the install-scripts CI prep (unused `dnf search`, hardcoded 3.12) and the shell version guard, which still permits 3.7+. The codebase should pick one shape and let tooling enforce it rather than shipping the discipline half-applied.
